advisory.problem: AC-003: the stock is checked only once, after the whole loop. An implementation could change the stock on one failing call and still pass if later effects cancel out. That is unlikely, and any net change is caught. Only AC-003 is affected.
advisory.evidence: An implementation that mutates and then raises would be caught here unless the mutations net to zero. Asserting quantity('A') == 5 after each failing call would be stricter.
